title: VirtualHub library entry metadata
description: meta.json inside %LOCALAPPDATA%\VRHub\library\<slug>\, written by either plugin after a successful publish. The homepage lists an entry only when meta.json, scene/scene.glb and scene/colliders.json all exist.

slug.description: Folder name; a slug of the document name, so re-exporting the same document replaces this entry.

name.description: Display name on the card. The document name, without the application's own name prefixed.

sourceLabel.description: e.g. 'Revit 2025' or 'IngeTrazo', shown as the card's pill.

fileName.description: Source file name including extension, when the host exposes it.

view.description: Revit 3D view name; null for IngeTrazo.

exportedUtc.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; the card list is sorted by it, newest first.
